question: How far does the professional evidence reach, which parts rest on an inference about another agency, and what is still undecidable from public sources?
answer_in_one_paragraph: 19,426 positions are complete on the 27 source fields. 18,680 positions have professional evidence independent of any cross-agency inference; 19 more are covered only by the 门类 rule on non-MOE positions and are therefore provisional; 727 have no catalog candidate at all. No residual phrase hides an exact in-scope catalog name that the matcher missed, so the remaining gap is semantic, cross-level or agency-internal, not a parser defect.

interpretation.semantic_conflict: The printed name belongs to a different code. This is the only family that indicates a genuine source inconsistency.
interpretation.multi_namespace_diagnostic: Same code naming something else at another education level, or a 类 suffix omitted by the source. These are diagnostics about how the text was resolved, not proof of an error.

conflict_audit.note: The 5 gate-code/name mismatches do not appear in the conflicts array; they are a separate reason class. The review bucket candidate_with_conflict counts review-universe positions and is not the library-wide structured conflict set.

residual_audit.scope_note: 181 national vocabulary/open scope + 13 agency unverified. The 533 agency positions with no public list found are reported separately and not re-litigated here.

verdict_meaning.exact_in_scope_unmatched: the catalog has this exact name in the position scope and the matcher missed it (a defect)
verdict_meaning.gate_scope_only: a gate name; only the provisional 门类 rule would resolve it
verdict_meaning.catalog_name_plus_类_suffix: the official node name plus a colloquial 类 (e.g. 中国语言文学类)
verdict_meaning.name_exists_only_in_other_education_leve: the name exists only for the other degree level
verdict_meaning.no_exact_catalog_node: no catalog node by that name in any scope
